programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería del Software: Cloud, Datos y Gestión de las Tecnologías de la Información
notes: 60 ECTS, 1 year. Programme page states language of instruction = Spanish (castellano). Page states código RUCT 4316602 (capture pending re-verification against RUCT itself). Three internal specialisation routes offered: Ingeniería Web, Ingeniería de Datos, Gestión de las Tecnologías de la Información — the page presents them as flexible itineraries rather than formally-named 'especialidades'. Cloud is in the title, so treated as a standalone AC programme, not a track. Accessed 2026-08-24.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Computación en la Nube y de Altas Prestaciones (Cloud and High-Performance Computing)
notes: 60 ECTS, 1 academic year, on-campus Valencia. UPV code MUCPD. Page states languages of instruction = castellano and valenciano; a B2 Spanish level is stated as required — a hard blocker for an A0/A1 Spanish speaker unless raised. 22 places offered for 2026-27. Page quotes a per-credit fee range of EUR 35.34–70.68/credit depending on student category — the higher band is the non-first-enrolment/non-subsidised rate and MUST be re-checked for the non-EU case in a deep-dive wave. Accessed 2026-08-24.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Desarrollo y Operaciones (DevOps)
discovery_source: WebSearch (Spanish); UNIR site returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch — details taken from UNIR's own indexed page text and plan-de-estudios URL
notes: Presented by UNIR as a MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO (official, registered in RUCT). 60 ECTS, fully online, Spanish. Curriculum explicitly DevOps/SRE: Cloud Computing, Cultura DevOps, Administración de Sistemas para Cloud, Automatización del Despliegue, SecDevOps, Administración de Redes, Herramientas DevOps, Contenedores, Integración y Despliegue Continuo, TFM 12 ECTS. Plan: https://www.unir.net/ingenieria/master-devops/plan-de-estudios/ . BLOCKER: unir.net blocks automated fetching (403) so official status + RUCT code could NOT be verified on the primary source in this wave — must be confirmed manually / via RUCT. Private online university. Accessed 2026-08-24.

programme_name: Master's Degree in Data Analysis, Cybersecurity and Cloud Computing (also marketed as 'Data Analysis, Cybersecurity and Development and Operations')
notes: Own site states 'official university master degree (título oficial)'. 90 ECTS over 1.5 years, on-campus Arrasate-Mondragón (Basque Country), 30 places. Languages stated as Spanish AND English — needs the exact 'idioma de impartición' split confirmed. Structure: 2 days class + 2.5 days PAID company internship from the start; entire 3rd semester in-company — unusually strong funding/earning angle for this candidate. Content covers high-availability cloud infrastructure design and DevOps. NOTE: the two title variants seen (Cloud Computing vs Development and Operations) appear on Mondragon's own pages — flag as possible title change, not resolved. Accessed 2026-08-24.

notes: Launched 2024-25 per Catalan tech press; described as virtual, ~15 months, taught in Catalan and Spanish.
